changes: Establish MOSS v1 as the baseline for the reusable code, separate from personal workspace data.
Retain the file-backed node and action model, Python validation, terminal interface, browser renderers, and existing node types.
Add the MOSS Change log system page and read-only API, backed by release notes stored with the code rather than personal memory.
Stop terminal startup from recording the obsolete v0.2 core version in the memory action log.
Document release versioning: code changes receive release notes; commands and memory edits remain in the action log.
Hide randomizer titles on parent pages by default, with a Show title on parent page option. Keep selected text and the title on the direct node view.
